correctness.rationale: For C6 the first circulant row is (1,a,b,c,b,a); its Fourier modes have eigenvalues L0=1+2a+2b+c (multiplicity 1), L1=1+a-b-c (2), L2=1-a-b+c (2), L3=1-2a+2b-c (1). Exact grid rational power bounds for 2^p and 3^p at endpoints 647/300 and 653/300 enclose all real p; Taylor polynomials of degrees 71 and 70 give rigorous lower/upper bounds on exp(-x) for nonnegative x. Sign margins at t=7/25,2/5,3/5 prove ++++,+++-,++++ respectively; continuity in t yields disconnected strict-positivity set. Independent direct evaluations for p=647/300,650/300,653/300 found L3 near 0.0122,0.00886,0.00551 at .28; -0.01845,-0.02195,-0.02546 at .4; 0.03851,0.03608,0.03368 at .6. This finite numeric check is corroboration only, not proof of uniform p. Exact certificate structure was inspected at pinned script and full-domain quantification checked.
residual_risks: Finite checks corroborate analytical arguments, not arbitrary real-parameter universality.

Strict loss and recovery of positive definiteness between two explicit bandwidths, robust over a nontrivial continuous power range, is a meaningful concrete obstruction not implied by the all-bandwidth negative-type theorem.
